main_text.p: Hæc Galenus, quibus quempiam esse mor-bum totius substantiæ Fernelius confirma-re contendit. Veruntamen Galenus his o-mnibus locis, & aliis, in quibus medica-mentorum, quæ à tota sua agunt substantia meminit, nihil aliud peripsam totam substan-tiam intelligit, quàm totius substantiæ proprietatem, quemadmodum alibi aper-tè demonstrat: præsertim extat unus maxi-mè omnium insignis locus commentario in secundum Hippocratis librum de Natu-ra humana, quem ipse Fernelius in suum usum citat, ubi Galenus in hunc modū scri-bit. In expirationibus (inquit) quæ proprie-tate totius substantiæ, magis quàm quali-tate corpora offendunt, rectè curationem tradidit Hippocrates in duplice redigens scopum, loci mutationem, & exiguæ inspi-rationis usum. Est & alius non minùs eui-dens libro de Simplicium medicamento-rum facultatibus undecimo, ubi de huius-modi proprietate ita loquitur. Fluuiatilium cancrorum cinis (inquit) quanquam simili-ter prædictis exiccatorius est, substantiæ ta-me proprietate mirabilis est eius in iis, qui à cane rabido sunt morsi, effectus. Quid'nā autem sit totius substantiæ proprietas, ipse quoq;
Hæc Galenus, quibus quempiam esse morbum totius substantiæ Fernelius confirmare contendit.

page.notes: Lines 1–20 of the text are set in a single column; the last line ends with a catchword "quoq;" at the right. The paragraph is run on without indent; treated as one paragraph. Several words are doubtful at the scan resolution: "substantiæ ta-me" (the printed line reads "substantiæ ta me"), "suum usum" (read as "suum ufum"), "exiguæ inspi-rationis" (printed "exiguę inspi-rationis"), "tota sua agunt" (printed "tota sua agunt"). Marked as read; no [?] assigned because they are legible on the scan at full size. The Galenic passage is copied as printed; "Hæc Galenus, quibus quempiam esse morbum" is the printed text, not a quotation from memory.
